_notes.name: The title on the page, 1 to 40 characters.
_notes.scale: The scale the pads play: major, minor, dorian, mixolydian, lydian, phrygian, harmonic-minor, major-pentatonic, minor-pentatonic, blues, or chromatic. It can be changed on the page too.
_notes.key: The key the grid starts on: C, C#, Db, D, D#, Eb, E, F, F#, Gb, G, G#, Ab, A, A#, Bb, or B.
_notes.voices: Which of the four voices to offer, in order: pluck, pad, bass, and keys. The first one is the voice the grid opens with.
_notes.grid: The pad grid: "5x8" (40 pads) or "6x10" (60 pads).
_notes.bpm: The tempo of the step ring, a whole number from 50 to 200.
_notes.theme: The look: aurora (polar green and rose), ember (fire and gold), or ink (indigo and vermilion). Each has a light and a dark side that follows the device.
